description: This file contains a series of shell test scripts designed to verify the behavior of Git notes fanout structure, including creation, deletion, and fanout transitions. It defines functions for testing fanout positions, performs multiple commit and note operations, and checks the correctness of fanout restructuring logic.

methods.name: path_has_fanout
methods.description: Checks if a given path has the specified fanout level based on directory structure.

methods.name: touched_one_note_with_fanout
methods.description: Determines whether a note modification (add or delete) at a specific commit has the intended fanout.

methods.name: all_notes_have_fanout
methods.description: Verifies whether all notes in a given commit have the specified fanout.
